name: RC-B10-0520/2026 - Après le § 7 - Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text: 7b. Calls on the United Nations and its member states to give due consideration to Milan as the potential host city for the new UN pillar, recognising its capacity to provide an effective, internationally connected and innovation-oriented home for this important initiative;
